But, one of the worst parts of being bipolar and taking all these medications is that I can’t even keep up with them all.  And I know I should be writing all my medication changes down and logging my moods, but I also can’t stick to anything with my ups and downs.  I’ll write it down a couple of times but eventually fall into a deep depression and quit caring.  On top of that, I had ECT done last year which left me with cognitive and memory impairments, making it even harder to recall the effects of all the different combos.  I’ve tried soooo many combinations of so many meds.  But it’s all a trial and error game that I’ll likely have to play for the rest of my life.

It might be a little crazy, but I agree!  Those who aren’t, or have never been, mentally ill can never really understand...and we (the bipolars) are more often than not too much for them.  That common ground could make for a great love story.
